tenderSchedule.description:
Combined Package for the following
Work A Establishing 2x20MVA 66/11kV Substation at Narasimhagiri(Belligatta) with construction of 66kV LILO line by using Drake Conductor from existing 66kV Gudekote-CJ Halli line to the proposed 66/11kV Narasimhgiri(Belligatta) substation for a distance of 0.679km in Kudligi Taluk, Vijaynagar District. Work B Construction of 66kV LILO line to 66kV Venkatapura Substation from existing 66kV MSD(Munirabad-Sokke-Davanagere) line for a distance of 0.952Kms along with Construction of 2 No. of 66kV Terminal Bays at existing 66/11kV Venkatapura sub-station for construction of 66kV LILO line from existing MSD line in Hosapete Taluk, Vijayanagara District on Partial Turnkey basis including supply of all matching materials/equipments (Excluding supply of 11 kV Switchgear) and erection (including civil works) of all materials/equipments, testing and commissioning.
